verdict.rationale: Perplexity's core product (web app, browser extension, mobile apps) delivers real-time web search with inline citations for every answer, well documented across docs and app listings (perplexity-docs-2, perplexity-docs-12, perplexity-docs-24, perplexity-docs-25). Community evidence corroborates heavy real-world use as a Google-replacement for grounded Q&A, though some users report citation/link mismatches and SEO-spam sources creeping into results, which affects reliability but does not negate that grounded, cited answers are delivered. Missing for 10: independent quantitative citation-accuracy testing and resolution of reports about citations being mismatched or sourced from low-quality listicle sites.
